shipping-policy.title: Shipping Policy
shipping-policy.html:
Customers can avail themselves of nationwide and worldwide shipping options when ordering online. We process one shipping address per order. If you would like to ship to a different address, you may consider placing separate orders and making payments for them separately. The shipping date depends on your preferred delivery location and delivery type. Please note that for locations Outside Dhaka, you need to collect the delivery items from your nearest courier branch.

 

The ordered product(s) will be delivered to customers under a Closed Box Delivery Policy****, according to the following timeline:

Delivery Location Order Time Delivery Type Cost Delivery Date
Inside Dhaka 00:00 – 23:59 hrs Regular BDT. 100/-*, Free for orders above BDT 7500/- Within 3-5 working days
Inside Dhaka Urgent 00:00 – 12:00 hrs Urgent BDT. 350/- Next Day 24 hrs**
Outside Dhaka 00:00 – 23:59 hrs Regular

BDT. 150/- (Sundarban Courier)

BDT. 250/- (SA Paribahan)

 Within 3-6 working days
Worldwide 00:00 – 23:59 hrs Regular Depends***

Depends***

 

 

*Delivery inside Dhaka city is free if the order value is TK. 7500 or above (Except Savasaachi product).
** Urgent delivery is not available on Fridays and govt. Holidays.
*** International delivery cost depends on the country of location and parcel’s weight or size. Contact our service center to get an estimated International delivery cost.

Closed Box Delivery Policy

****All deliveries are Closed Box, meaning products cannot be returned to the delivery personnel. In case of any anomaly, mismatch, or product issue, customers should record a video while opening the package and contact the Service Center.

 

How do I check the status of my order?

You can easily track your order using the Order History option after logging in to our website or call our Service Center hotline.

 

My items haven’t arrived yet. What can I do?

First, try to track your order using your order ID from the Order History page by logging in to the website or platform. Or you can call our Service Center hotline for this information.

 

What if I am not there to receive the order?

Someone on your behalf will receive the order. In this case, we would require verification (phone, SMS, order ID, etc.) & filling out the acknowledgment form to receive the order.

 

What can I do in case of delayed delivery?

Sometimes, the product delivery may get delayed due to unavoidable circumstances, and it might exceed the delivery schedule mentioned above. If you have any queries regarding the delivery, please reach us through our Service Center Hotline.

 

What if I receive wrong products or an incorrect quantity?

In case of receiving the wrong products or an incorrect quantity, please share an unboxing video of your received delivery package(s).

Upon verification, we will arrange for a replacement or adjust your order accordingly.

 

Shipping Details of Savasaachi Products (Furniture)

 

Shipping Terms:

  • Urgent delivery is not applicable for Savasaachi products.

  • Free installation services will be provided by Savasaachi after delivery. 

  • International delivery services are not available for Savasaachi products.

 

Here are the delivery details that we follow:

privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy-policy.html:
We expect you to carefully go through this Privacy Policy before using www.savasaachi.com. Here, “We”, “Us”, “Our”, “Website”, “Site”, “System”, “Platforms” includes (All Social Media, Mobile App, Wearable Technology) will refer to Savasaachi and “You”, “Your”, “User” will refer to Customers and Visitors.

We are committed to providing the highest level of privacy protection for all of our customers. This privacy policy helps you understand the range of information we might collect from you upon your visit to the website and its subpages. This page also clarifies how we may use and process information from the choices you make when using the site.

 

Regarding the Information Collected

When you visit the website and its subpages, use our services, place an order, make a purchase, participate in our Loyalty Program, or contact us, we collect your identifiable information, for example, your name, phone number, email address, etc. Please be informed that we also keep records of your browsing history and interests to enhance your user experience on our site.

 

Personal Identification Information (PII)

We may adopt several ways to gather PII from users. The following occasions might include: when you visit the site or platforms and perform certain activities such as filling out forms, registering, using the site’s services, resources, or features we make available on it. You may be requested to share your email address. You also have the option to visit the site anonymously. We might collect your PII only if you deliberately submit such kind of information. Please note that you can always avoid providing PII unless that might obstruct you from engaging in certain activities on the site.

 

Non-Personal Identification Information

We may also collect your non-personal identification information when you interact with the site or platforms. Here, the non-personal identification information may include browser information, computer specification, and other related technical information as to how you connect to the site and platforms, for instance, the Internet Service Provider (ISP), the Operating System (OS), or other similar information.

 

Browser Cookies

Cookies are bits of information that a website collects about the web browser and user preferences and saves them on the computer’s hard disk to create a customized user experience. Our site and platforms may also use cookies for the same purpose. You can always set your web browser to reject cookies or notify you when cookies are being sent. If you do not allow your browser to accept cookies or manually stop them from being saved, the site or platforms will not be able to offer you a personalized user experience.

 

How do we use the Collected Information?

Improve customer service: Any information that you may provide us with helps us respond to your customer service support requests more efficiently.

To run a survey, promotion, or other features of the Site: The information that you send to us to receive services will help us offer you an optimized user experience.

Send periodic emails: We may use the email addresses of our users to keep them posted with updates, feeds, and other relevant information pertaining to their interests and order. This may also help us come up with an even better response to their inquiries and requests. When a user registers to our mailing service, he or she might receive recurring emails that could contain updates, newsletters, company news, and information about relevant services. Users on our site can always unsubscribe from email subscriptions.

 

Your Information and Our Promise

We prioritize the privacy and security of customers’ personal information. We adopt some of the most secure and technologically advanced storage systems, data collection methods, and processing practices and take tight security measures to protect our site and platforms against unauthorized or illegal access, disclosure, alteration, or destruction of Users’ passwords, personal information, usernames, and transaction information stored on the site and platforms.

 

Sharing our Users’ Personal Information

We never sell, trade, or rent our users’ PII to any third party or other. However, we may share generic aggregated demographic information that is not linked to any PII or whatsoever about visitors or users with any of our business partners, advertisers or trusted affiliates for the purposes stated above. Please note that we may occasionally need to use third-party services to operate certain aspects of our business and administer activities from our end, such as monetary transactions, sending out newsletters, or surveys. In that case, we might have to share the site’s users’ information with these third parties to ensure certain services provided that the visitors of the site have permitted us to do so.

 

Modification

We reserve the right to modify, extend or bring any updates to this privacy policy at any time without prior notice. Upon bringing an update, we will put the updated date at the bottom of the page. Users are requested to visit this page frequently to remain informed about any changes as to how and in what manner we protect the personal information that we collect from our users. You agree and acknowledge that it falls into your responsibility to check this privacy policy frequently and remain informed about modifications.

 

Your Acceptance of these Terms

You consciously accept the Privacy Policy of the site and platforms by using it all the time. If you do not wish to give consent to any or all terms of this Privacy Policy, please stop using this website immediately. Your continued use of the site and platform, even after changes being made to this policy, will be regarded as your acceptance of these modifications.

payment-policy.title: Payment Policy
payment-policy.html:
To begin purchasing from the site (www.savasaachi.com) or platform, you may be required to register using a valid phone number and password. It is your sole responsibility to keep such information/log-in details secure. We shall not be held responsible if such information/log-in details are provided to a third party by the customer or if any third party receives the same due to the negligence of the customer and for any loss incurred as a result of the above-mentioned incidents (unauthorized access to data).

There are two types of payment options:

  1. Cash on Delivery
  2. Online Payment

Cash on delivery: If the delivery location is inside Dhaka, our delivery agent will collect the cash after delivering the ordered product(s). For deliveries outside Dhaka, the customer has to pay the due amount to the courier service before collecting the product(s).

Online payment options: You can make payments using Visa Card, MasterCard, American Express (AMEX), CityTouch, DBBL Nexus, BRAC Bank, bKash, Nagad, Rocket, Sure Cash, Fast Cash, Tap’n Pay, T-Cash, Upay, MyCash, IBBL MCash, Q-Cash, Bank Asia, IBBL, AB Bank, MTB, OK Wallet, Dmoney and UnionPay.

 

Are there any International Payment methods?

Yes, you can pay using MasterCard, VISA and American Express (AMEX). Please note, you will be asked for proof of identity.

 

Are there any hidden charges?

No, there are no hidden charges. All payment information will be shown on the checkout page. Payment will include delivery charges and VAT accordingly. You will only pay the amount shown on the checkout page.

 

Will my information related to payment be secured?

Rest assured, we ensure the safety of your sensitive information. However, we do not retain card information to comply with regulatory guidelines. All information related to your card/bank account will be exclusively dealt with by the payment gateway. We will ensure that the 2FA (Two Factor Authentication) is verified for payment.

 

What if my card has been declined?

For any card decline or unsuccessful payment requests, you must contact the bank or the concerned financial institution that issued your card/ financial services. For any queries related to payment, please contact your bank/financial service provider.

 

Payment Terms and Conditions for Savasaachi (Furniture) Products

 

Order Placement and payment:

  • A 10% advance payment is required to confirm and place an order. Otherwise, the order will not be confirmed.

  • The remaining payment can be made using either Cash on Delivery (COD) or Online Payment.

  • Full payment is required before delivery for orders outside Dhaka.

 

Payment Options:

We offer two convenient payment methods:

Cash on Delivery: For locations within Dhaka, our delivery agent will collect payment upon delivering the ordered product(s). For deliveries outside Dhaka, customers must pay the full amount before delivery is initiated.

 

Online Payment: Securely make payments using Visa Card, MasterCard, American Express (AMEX), CityTouch, DBBL Nexus, BRAC Bank, bKash, Nagad, Rocket, Sure Cash, Fast Cash, Tap’n Pay, T-Cash, Upay, MyCash, IBBL MCash, Q-Cash, Bank Asia, IBBL, AB Bank, MTB, OK Wallet, Dmoney, and UnionPay.

 

Order Cancellation

  • Orders must be canceled within 24 hours after placing the order. The customer has to request a cancellation by contacting our Customer Service department.

  • Customers are eligible for a refund if the order is canceled within the first 24 hours, and the refund will be processed using the same payment method used for the advance payment.

  • The advance payment becomes non-refundable if the cancellation is made after the initial 24-hour window.

 

FAQs.

Q: Can I purchase with EMI having Zero percent interest?

Ans: Currently the EMI facility is not applicable for Savasaachi products.  

Q: Does Savasaachi take bulk orders for commercial projects?

Ans: Savasaachi take bulk orders for commercial projects. To learn more about bulk orders, please contact our customer service at 09666774577.

gift-card-policy.title: Gift Card Policy
gift-card-policy.html:
Savasaachi Gift Card Policy

Introduction 

ILLIIYEEN Gift Cards offer a seamless gifting experience for our valued customers. The following policy outlines the terms and conditions for purchasing, redeeming, and managing ILLIIYEEN Gift Cards, applicable both in stores and online.

Purchasing an ILLIIYEEN Gift Card

  • ILLIIYEEN Gift Cards are available for purchase at all ILLIIYEEN retail stores and online (www.savasaachi.com).

  • Customers can select from predefined amounts– BDT5,000 and BDT10,000.

  • Gift Cards are packaged in a sealed envelope, ensuring security and a unique redemption code is securely assigned to each Gift Card.

  • No discount is applicable for purchasing an Savasaachi Gift Card.

  • Gift cards cannot be purchased using a Gift Card.

  • No VAT applies to the purchase of Gift Cards.

Redemption Process

  • Gift Cards can be redeemed online by entering the unique redemption code at checkout.

  • In-store redemption requires presenting the Gift Card at the billing counter.

  • An OTP verification process ensures the security of each transaction.

  • A Gift Card can only be used once, and the full amount must be redeemed in a single transaction. Any remaining balance cannot be redeemed for a next purchase.

  • If the purchase amount exceeds the Gift Card balance, the remaining amount must be paid using an alternative payment method.

  • Only one gift card can be redeemed in a single order.

Validity and Expiry

  • ILLIIYEEN Gift Cards are valid for one year from the date of activation.

  • Expired Gift Cards cannot be reactivated or refunded.

Refunds, Returns, and Exchanges

  • Gift Cards are non-refundable, non-exchangeable, and cannot be redeemed for cash or credit.

  • Purchases made using a Gift Card are not eligible for refunds but may be exchanged if they meet the Exchange Policy requirements.

  • Products belonging to an invoice that include Gift Card payment are non-refundable but exchangeable upon meeting Exchange Policy requirements.

Security and Lost Cards

  • The redemption code associated with a Gift Card must be kept secure by the recipient.

  • If a Gift Card is lost, stolen, or compromised, it must be reported immediately to ILLIIYEEN Service Center.

  • In cases of loss or theft, the redemption code may be deactivated and a replacement issued at the discretion of ILLIIYEEN, subject to verification.

  • Redeemed Gift Cards cannot be reported as lost or stolen. So, the reporting of a lost or stolen Gift Card must be done before it is redeemed.

Loyalty Points

  • Customers earn Royalty Points when purchasing an Savasaachi Gift Card, but not on the amount redeemed, though points apply to any additional value paid beyond the card.

Compliance and Amendments

  • ILLIIYEEN reserves the right to modify or update this Gift Card Policy at any time without prior notice.

  • By purchasing or using an ILLIIYEEN Gift Card, customers agree to abide by the terms and conditions outlined in this policy.

For further assistance, please contact Savasaachi Service Center at 09666774577 or via email at support@savasaachi.com.

exchange-return.title: Exchange & Refund
exchange-return.html:
We allow our customers to exchange or return a product abiding by conditions set for the purpose. You may apply for an Exchange or Refund within 7 days after you’ve received it.

 

Conditions for Exchange/Return and Refund:

  • The product must be unused, unworn, unwashed, unaltered, and without any flaws. Products can be tried on to see if they fit and will still be considered unworn.

  • The product must be intact with tags.

  • An exchange or return request must be done within 7 days of the purchase.

  • All items must be returned in original condition (including all receipts/invoices and packaging) with barcode tags attached.

  • Each Product is eligible for a single exchange only.

  • Refunds will be processed and issued to the original payment method used for the purchase.

  • Exchanges or refunds are not applicable for items offered at 50% or higher, and products on Flash Sale.

  • To report a damaged, or missing product, please share an unboxing video for verification.

  • For furniture products by Savasaachi, no exchange and return is applicable unless any manufacturing defect is identified 72 hours days from the date of delivery.

  • No exchange or refund is applicable for accessories items.

What if I lose the money receipt/tags/barcode?

  • We will consider it if you lose the money receipt or invoice for exchanges. In that case, you will need to provide the purchase contact number so we can check your purchase history. 

  • The exchange offer will no longer be valid for any irreparable damage to the tags or barcode.

 

From where can I exchange the product? 

  • For Online Purchase

After purchasing any product(s) you can exchange it/them at any of our Stores within 7 days of the receiving date. To find your nearest Store, please click here. You can also send us your product(s) by any courier service after consulting with our Service Center associate. After receiving the product, we will contact you and arrange the shipment of your exchange product. It should meet all the conditions specified in the Conditions for Exchange and Return section.

Please note, if there is any problem from our side, we will offer free returns, exchanges, or refunds otherwise, the customer will have to bear the expenses of the return shipping. 

  • For Purchase Made at the Store

Currently, we have twenty three Stores across Bangladesh. If you are not satisfied with your purchase, please bring the product to any of our Stores within 7 days after the product is received and it should meet all the conditions specified in the Conditions for Exchange and Return section.

Refund Policy

If you are not satisfied with your purchase, you can return the product and get a full refund as per our exchange/return/refund conditions.

For Online purchase: Please return the product to us after consulting with the Service Center and we will arrange a full refund within 10 working days after receiving the returned product(s) upon the fulfillment of our Exchange and Refund Conditions. If there is any problem from our side we will offer free returns, exchanges, or refunds otherwise, the customer has to bear the expense for the return shipping.

* Depending on the shipping method and carrier selection, your return package may take several days to reach us. Keep your proof of postage and ship your return along with the reference number as we are not liable for return packages that are lost or stolen in transit. Without proof of receipt and delivery, we will not issue store credit for your returns.

For Store purchase: Please bring the product to the Store from where you made your purchase. We will arrange a refund upon the fulfillment of our Exchange and Refund Conditions.

Receiving Incorrect Quantity and Product Mismatch at Delivery:

If you receive the wrong products or an incorrect quantity, you must provide an unboxing video of your delivered package(s) to support your claim. Upon verification, we will arrange for a replacement or adjust your order accordingly.

 

How do you return the product(s) to us for Exchange or Refund? 

 

Return to the Store

Please bring the product(s) to any of our Stores. We will arrange for an exchange or refund upon the fulfillment of our Exchange and Refund Conditions.

 

SA Paribahan 

Send the product to SA Paribahan at Kuril Branch. Please use this address and contact number given below:

Name: Savasaachi 

Contact number : 01885-999-006

Note: Please send us the SA Paribahan receipt number for your reference.

 

Sundarban Courier

Send the product to Sundarban Courier at Baridhara Branch. Please use this address and contact number given below:

Name: Savasaachi

Contact number : 01885-999-006

Note: Please send us the Sundarban Courier receipt number for your reference.
 

Warranty and Guaranty Terms for Savasaachi Products (Furniture)

 

 Coverage

  • This warranty exclusively covers manufacturing faults present in our products.

  • The warranty is applicable for a period of one year from the date of delivery of the product.

 Repair or Replacement

loyalty-program.title: Loyalty Program
loyalty-program.html:
Welcome to Savasaachi Loyalty Program!

Through this program, you will have the privilege to earn redeemable Loyalty Points on your every valued purchase. Loyalty Points earned can be redeemed for discounts on future purchases.

 

Enjoy three types of Savasaachi Loyalty Status:

  • SILVER is the primary Loyalty Status that makes you eligible for earning Loyalty Points. You can enjoy Silver Loyalty Status by signing up for the Loyalty Program at any Savasaachi Store or on your Savasaachi Online Store Account. As a Silver Status holder, you can earn one (01) Loyalty Point for every BDT 100 worth of purchase.
  • GOLD is the standard Loyalty Status. By purchasing products worth BDT 100,000 or more (less than BDT 300,000) within a span of one year or less, you can upgrade to Gold Loyalty Status from Silver Status instantly. For Gold Status, three (03) Loyalty Points are earned for every BDT 100 worth of purchase.
  • PLATINUM is the highest Loyalty Status that can be secured by purchasing products worth BDT 300,000 or more within a span of one year or less. As a Platinum Loyalty Status holder, you can earn five (05) points for every BDT 100 worth of purchase. Platinum Status also comes with special privileges and additional benefits.

 

How to Sign Up

Signing up is super simple. Initially, you can sign up for the Loyalty Program and obtain a Loyalty Card by providing your name and contact information at any Savasaachi Store.

You can also sign up on your Savasaachi Online Store Account by filling out a Loyalty Program Form.

 

How to Track Points

You can easily track your Loyalty Points in three ways:

  • By logging in to your Savasaachi Online Store Account
  • By visiting Savasaachi Stores
  • By contacting Savasaachi Service Center

 

Important Terms

  1. Your Loyalty Status will be determined by the amount of purchase you make within a span of 1 year (365 days).
  2. You will be eligible to redeem Loyalty Points in multiples of 100 points.
  3. At least 100 Loyalty Points are required to redeem the earned points.
  4. Earned Loyalty Points are not refundable as cash.
  5. In all cases, one Loyalty Point equals BDT 1.
  6. Savasaachi reserves the right to bring changes to the Loyalty Program’s terms and conditions at any time without prior notice.

 

For further assistance, feel free to call us up at 09666774577. We are available from 09:00 AM. to 06:00 AM, 7 days a week!

Our mission is to serve our customers
